# artisanvirt_node (Data Source)

Looks up one hypervisor node, with inventory and allocation, by id or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "artisanvirt_node" "hv01" {
  name = "hv01"
}

output "hv01_free_pools" {
  value = { for p in data.artisanvirt_node.hv01.storage_pools : p.name => p.available_bytes }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Node id. Exactly one of `id` or `name` is required.
- `name` (String) Node name.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Agent address.
- `addresses` (List of String) Host IP addresses.
- `agent_version` (String) Agent version.
- `allocated_disk_gib` (Number) Disk allocated to VMs.
- `allocated_memory_mib` (Number) Memory allocated to VMs.
- `allocated_vcpus` (Number) vCPUs allocated to VMs.
- `arch` (String) CPU architecture.
- `bridges` (List of String) Host bridges.
- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster id, empty for standalone nodes.
- `cluster_name` (String) Cluster name.
- `cpu_cores` (Number) CPU cores.
- `cpu_model` (String) CPU model.
- `hostname` (String) Host name.
- `kernel` (String) Kernel version.
- `kvm_available` (Boolean)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `libvirt_version` (String) libvirt version.
- `membership` (String) `joining` or `leaving` while a membership change runs.
- `memory_bytes` (Number) Physical memory.
- `networks` (List of String) libvirt networks.
- `online` (Boolean) Heartbeat is recent.
- `os` (String) Operating system.
- `os_version` (String) OS version.
- `state` (String) `discovered`, `provisioning`, `ready`, `maintenance`, `degraded`, `offline`, `quarantined`, `rejected` or `decommissioning`.
- `state_message` (String) Detail for the state.
- `storage_pools` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_pools))
- `vm_count` (Number) VMs on the node.

<a id="nestedatt--storage_pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storage_pools`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean)
- `available_bytes` (Number)
- `capacity_bytes` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `path` (String)
- `type` (String)
